data.title: Playa Del Sol
data.about:
Playa Del Sol at Al Marjan Island, RAK, is an upcoming luxury project by Ellington Properties. The 14-storey building offers an exceptional range of apartments, from studios to 2 bedrooms. You can also choose from the signature residences, including 3-bedroom duplex apartments, two 4-bedroom penthouses and a signature 5-bedroom villa with a private pool and garden. 

Apartments for sale at Playa Del Sol feature spacious interiors and stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and Wynn Resort. It blends modern aesthetics with the tranquillity of coastal living, offering the perfect retreat for relaxation and comfort. Enjoy stunning sunrise and sunset vistas from your apartment’s balcony or unwind at the beach. The ideal vacation home is available with just a 20% down payment.

characteristics_module.title: A Perfect Sanctuary Crafted For Relaxation & Recreation
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Modern Housing: A range of elegant homes to choose from. Purchase a cozy studio apartment or an expansive villa with a private pool.
  • Ample Parking Facilities: A spacious parking area offering 709 bays, ensuring convenient parking for residents and guests.
  • EV Charging Points: Stay eco-friendly with 10 electric vehicle (EV) charging points available on-site, perfect for modern, sustainable living.
  • Exclusive Private Jetty: Enjoy a luxurious lifestyle with a private jetty for residents, offering direct transportation to the nearby casino for a truly elite experience.
  • Modern Lift System: Equipped with 6 high-speed lifts and 2 dedicated service lifts, ensuring seamless vertical transportation throughout the building.
  • Breathtaking Arabian Gulf Views: Experience stunning views of the Arabian Gulf right from your residence, providing a serene coastal atmosphere.
  • Prime Location Near Wynn Resort: Enjoy unparalleled proximity to the prestigious casino resort, offering exclusive access to world-class entertainment and luxury.
  • Unparalleled Amenities: Indulge in premium facilities on the ground and 1st floors, designed for relaxation and recreation, including a clubhouse, wellness spa, and more.

location_tile.title: Enjoy Perfect Waterfront Living at Al Marjan Island
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Playa Del Sol on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah offers an idyllic coastal retreat, combining luxury and tranquility in one of the UAE's most sought-after destinations.

Nestled in the heart of this beautiful island, the development provides residents with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and easy access to pristine beaches. This exclusive location is perfect for those seeking a peaceful, resort-like lifestyle, while still being connected to the vibrant city of Ras Al Khaimah.

  • Wynn Resort - 4 Minutes
  • Al Hamra Mall - 8 Minutes
  • RAK Central - 9 Minutes
  • Al Hamra Golf Club - 10 Minutes
  • Royal Yacht Club of Ras Al Khaimah - 12 Minutes
  • RAK Track -  - 12 Minutes

more_info.answer: The payment plan for Playa Del Sol by Ellington Properties starts with a 20% down payment at booking. After 90 days, you pay 10%, followed by another 10% after 180 days. Subsequent payments of 5% are made at 20%, 30%, 40%, and 50% project completion milestones. The final 40% is due upon project completion.
